description: This file implements centralized error handling middleware for an ASP.NET Core Web API project. It provides mechanisms to convert exceptions into standardized HTTP responses with ProblemDetails, logs errors appropriately, and maps specific exceptions to HTTP status codes.

classes.name: ApiErrorHandling
classes.description: A static class providing methods to register global exception handling middleware and map exceptions to HTTP responses with detailed ProblemDetails.

methods.name: UseUnifiedExceptionHandling
methods.description: Extension method to register a global exception handler middleware that captures unhandled exceptions and converts them into standardized error responses.

methods.name: ToResult
methods.description: Converts a caught Exception into an IResult containing a ProblemDetails object, mapping specific exception types to HTTP status codes and titles.
